title: ACEF Incident Card Payload (public projection of incident_report)
description: Payload schema for the public incident_card record (RFC-0002 Appendix B; ACEF core_version 1.1.0). The public projection of an incident_report, generated under the §5.11 publishability map. Closed (additionalProperties: false); unknown keys MUST be x-*-namespaced elsewhere in the envelope to be safely ignorable. The frozen incident_report (acef-conventions/v1/) is unchanged. The harm_class enum, taxonomy_crosswalk member subschemas, coordinated_disclosure shape, and severity_vector grammar are referenced from companion v1.1 schemas, not inlined.

public_incident_id.description: Assigner-scoped, non-enumerable, self-asserted federated handle of the form AIIC-{assigner}-{year}-{suffix}: assigner is 2-8 uppercase alphanumerics, year is 4 digits, and the suffix is >=26 Crockford-base32 chars [0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z] (>=128 bits of entropy). Lifecycle state (supersedes/merged_from/split_into) is held out-of-band in the §5.3 id-state document. The handle is self-asserted, NOT a forgery-resistant credential: offline-deterministic validation checks pattern + JWS self-consistency only and never attributes the id to the assigner domain. Carries id_grade (§5.3).

id_grade.description: Trust grade of public_incident_id (§5.3). Pinned to 'self-asserted' on the v1.1 schema surface; 'registry-canonical' is reserved for the v1.2 schema surface (§11) and is therefore rejected here, matching the v1.1 validator (§5.3, §6).

severity.description: Coarse rating; MUST equal band(severity_vector) when the vector is present (§5.4; ACEF-088).

harm_core.description: Cross-taxonomy harm core (§5.2). realization, causality, and harm_class are closed enums; harm_class is keyed to Art.3(49)(a-d) via the harm-core-taxonomy companion schema.

incident_dedupe_key.description: Cross-DB dedupe spine (§5.5). Emitted ONLY on public records; omit on non-public.

incident_dedupe_key_hmac.description: Keyed variant for redacted-subject dedupe; pepper held by the §5.3 resolver.

severity_vector.description: Recomputable vector (§5.4). The coarse `severity` enum MUST equal band(severity_vector).

harm_distribution_basis.description: Closed CSETv1 axis (§5.2). GDPR Art.9 special-category; §5.11 governs publishability (regulator-only by default; a *_commitment field carries the hash-committed form).

taxonomy_crosswalk.description: Closed, version-pinned members; derived projections of harm_core (§5.5).

declared_publication_basis.description: Declared (not adjudicated) basis required before publishing special-category/identifying fields (§5.11).

^[a-z0-9_]+_commitment$.description: Hash-committed projection of a non-public source field (§5.11), e.g. description_commitment, harm_distribution_basis_commitment. Value MUST equal 'sha256:' + hex(SHA-256(JCS(source_value))) at the source path whose §5.11 disposition is hash-committed (commitment-linkage; orphan/mismatch raises ACEF-086).

^x-[a-z0-9-]+/?$.description: X6 vendor-extension namespace (§5.5 / Appendix E Q15; repo pattern v1.1/manifest.schema.json:96-102). Any `x-*`-namespaced key is accepted, safely-ignorable, preserved on round-trip, and MUST NOT affect conformance. Non-`x-`, non-`_commitment` unknown top-level keys remain rejected by additionalProperties: false.
